verdict.rationale: Event-driven notifications are a fair capability for a state business-registry portal, so this axis applies. The evidence shows only email notification and email-update subscriptions (colorado-sos-docs-11, colorado-sos-docs-27). These are adjacent alerting features, not user-defined rules that automatically trigger actions on events. The keyless Socrata data API is a developer building block hosted on the open-data platform, not a rules engine.
